notes: This portable scenario exercises the official named joinFederationExecution overload. A second connected federate first attempts the active member's name and must receive FederateNameAlreadyInUse, then joins under a distinct adapter-derived name and receives a distinct FederateHandle. It uses only the official IEEE 1516.1-2025 C++ API and standard library. The scenario mirrors the duplicate-name condition in java-tck.federation-membership without provider-specific behavior.

api_surfaces.signature: virtual FederateHandle joinFederationExecution(std::wstring const & federateName, std::wstring const & federateType, std::wstring const & federationName, std::vector<std::wstring> const & additionalFomModules = std::vector<std::wstring>()) = 0
